snippet.title: 국토교통부 × 뽕이냐락이냐  - 기내 반입 보조배터리 제한 (락 ver.)
snippet.description:
국토교통부가 뽕이냐 락이냐와 함께한 “기내 반입 보조배터리 제한” 캠페인 영상입니다. 
락 기반에 일렉트로닉 등 여러 신나는 장르를 더한 강렬한 사운드로, 
보조배터리 화재 위험성을 직관적으로 전달합니다. 
썸네일 속 1인칭 시점의 기내 복도와, 불꽃이 튀는 보조배터리 이미지는 
작은 부주의가 큰 사고로 이어질 수 있음을 상징합니다.

2026년 4월 20일부터 국제 기준이 시행됩니다. 핵심은 단 하나-
보조배터리는 1인당 최대 2개까지만 반입 가능, 
그리고 기내 충전 및 사용은 전면 금지입니다. 
이번 기준은 국제민간항공기구(ICAO)에서 채택된 글로벌 표준으로, 
국가별 규정 차이로 인한 혼선을 줄이고 항공 안전을 강화하기 위해 마련되었습니다.

안전은 선택이 아니라 필수입니다. 
탑승 전 반드시 규정을 확인하고, 모두의 안전한 비행을 위해 함께 지켜주세요.

id.title: Maksudmu KTX dan SRT itu performanya hampir sama? 🚄
id.description:
Perang memperebutkan tiket kereta setiap akhir pekan…

Pernahkah Anda berpikir, “Seandainya ada satu kereta lagi”? 👀

Sekarang, KTX dan SRT terhubung dan beroperasi bersama! 🚄🚄

Melalui operasi kereta ganda, di mana dua kereta beroperasi sebagai satu,

sekitar 2.870 kursi tambahan per minggu diamankan untuk keberangkatan dan kedatangan di Stasiun Suseo,

dan kereta ganda percontohan dapat digunakan dengan harga setara SRT,

dengan diskon 10% untuk tarif KTX.

Reservasi tersedia melalui aplikasi dan situs web Korail dan SR,

dan di loket tiket stasiun dan mesin tiket otomatis! 🎫

Peningkatan kapasitas tempat duduk dan pengurangan beban

Operasi Kereta Ganda KTX-SRT

membuat perjalanan kereta Anda sedikit lebih nyaman.

en-US.title: You're saying the KTX and SRT run together? 🚄
en-US.description:
The war for train tickets every weekend…

Have you ever thought, “I wish there were just one more train”? 👀

Now, KTX and SRT are connected and run together! 🚄🚄

Through double-heading operations, where two trains operate as one,

approximately 2,870 additional seats per week are secured for departures and arrivals at Suseo Station,

and the pilot double-heading trains can be used at SRT-level prices,

with a 10% discount on KTX fares.

Reservations are available via the Korail and SR apps and websites,

and at station ticket counters and automatic ticket machines! 🎫

Increased seating capacity and lowered burden

snippet.description:
국토교통부가 뽕이냐 락이냐와 함께한 “기내 반입 보조배터리 제한” 캠페인 영상입니다. 
락 기반에 일렉트로닉 등 여러 신나는 장르를 더한 강렬한 사운드로, 
보조배터리 화재 위험성을 직관적으로 전달합니다. 
썸네일 속 1인칭 시점의 기내 복도와, 불꽃이 튀는 보조배터리 이미지는 
작은 부주의가 큰 사고로 이어질 수 있음을 상징합니다.

2026년 4월 20일부터 국제 기준이 시행됩니다. 핵심은 단 하나-
보조배터리는 1인당 최대 2개까지만 반입 가능, 
그리고 기내 충전 및 사용은 전면 금지입니다. 
이번 기준은 국제민간항공기구(ICAO)에서 채택된 글로벌 표준으로, 
국가별 규정 차이로 인한 혼선을 줄이고 항공 안전을 강화하기 위해 마련되었습니다.

id.title: Kementerian Pertanahan, Infrastruktur dan Transportasi × ​​Bbong-i-nyarak-i-nya - Pembatasan Powe...
id.description:
Ini adalah video kampanye untuk "Pembatasan Power Bank Portabel yang Dibawa di Dalam Pesawat" yang diproduksi oleh Kementerian Pertanahan, Infrastruktur, dan Transportasi bekerja sama dengan *Bbong or Rock*.

Dengan suara yang intens yang menggabungkan fondasi rock dengan berbagai genre menarik seperti musik elektronik,

video ini secara intuitif menyampaikan risiko kebakaran yang terkait dengan power bank portabel.

Tampilan perspektif orang pertama dari lorong pesawat dalam thumbnail dan gambar power bank yang mengeluarkan percikan api melambangkan bahwa bahkan kecerobohan kecil pun dapat menyebabkan kecelakaan besar.

Standar internasional akan diterapkan mulai 20 April 2026. Poin kuncinya hanya satu hal:

Power bank portabel dibatasi maksimal dua per orang,

dan pengisian daya serta penggunaannya di dalam pesawat dilarang keras.

Standar ini adalah standar global yang diadopsi oleh Organisasi Penerbangan Sipil Internasional (ICAO) dan ditetapkan untuk mengurangi kebingungan yang disebabkan oleh perbedaan peraturan nasional dan untuk memperkuat keselamatan penerbangan.

Keselamatan bukanlah pilihan, tetapi suatu keharusan.

Pastikan untuk memeriksa peraturan sebelum naik pesawat dan patuhi bersama demi keselamatan penerbangan semua orang.

en-US.title: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport × Bbong-i-nyarak-i-nya - Carry-on Portable Power B...
en-US.description:
This is the campaign video for the "Restriction on Carry-on Portable Power Banks" produced by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport in collaboration with *Bbong or Rock*.

With an intense sound that combines rock foundations with various exciting genres such as electronic music,

it intuitively conveys the fire risks associated with portable power banks.

The first-person perspective view of the airplane aisle in the thumbnail and the image of a power bank sparking symbolize that even small carelessness can lead to a major accident.

International standards will be implemented starting April 20, 2026. The key point is just one thing:

Portable power banks are limited to a maximum of two per person,

and charging and using them on board are strictly prohibited.

These standards are global standards adopted by the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) and were established to reduce confusion caused by differences in national regulations and to strengthen aviation safety.

Safety is not an option, but a necessity.

Please be sure to check the regulations before boarding and follow them together for everyone's safe flight.

en-US.title: When is the busiest time on the road? 🚗
en-US.description:
When is the busiest time of day on the road? 👀

The answer is right between 4 PM and 5 PM!

By day of the week, Friday had the highest traffic volume, and by vehicle type, passenger cars, followed by trucks and buses, drove the most on the roads 🚙🚚🚌

And if you convert the 2025 road traffic volume into driving distance…

That’s a whopping 13,094 laps around the Earth 🌍😳

Check out the video for the 2025 road traffic volume survey results, which are even more surprising once you know the details!

id.title: Kapan waktu tersibuk di jalan raya? 🚗
id.description:
Kapan waktu tersibuk di jalan raya? 👀

Jawabannya tepat antara pukul 4 sore dan 5 sore!

Berdasarkan hari dalam seminggu, Jumat memiliki volume lalu lintas tertinggi, dan berdasarkan jenis kendaraan, mobil penumpang, diikuti oleh truk dan bus, paling banyak melintas di jalan raya 🚙🚚🚌

Dan jika Anda mengkonversi volume lalu lintas jalan raya tahun 2025 menjadi jarak tempuh…

Itu setara dengan 13.094 putaran mengelilingi Bumi 🌍😳

Lihat video untuk hasil survei volume lalu lintas jalan raya tahun 2025, yang bahkan lebih mengejutkan setelah Anda mengetahui detailnya!

id.title: “Apakah kamu akan sering bepergian jika menjadi masinis kereta api?” Jawaban yang realistis 🚆
id.description:
Kami telah menelusuri secara menyeluruh dari A sampai Z tentang apa yang dilakukan seorang masinis kereta api 👀

👉 Surat Izin Mengemudi Kereta Api → Wajib untuk Rekrutmen Terbuka

👉 Saat Anda tiba di tempat kerja, semuanya dimulai dengan tes napas → pelatihan keselamatan → inspeksi peralatan!

Hal terpenting saat mengoperasikan kereta!

👀 Rasa kantuk? Bukan soal menahannya, tetapi pencegahannya.

💪 Menjaga kebugaran dan kondisi fisik sangat penting.

“Karena Anda bepergian ke seluruh negeri, Anda pasti sering bepergian, kan?”

👉 Kenyataannya… tidak semudah yang Anda bayangkan 😂

Pekerjaan dengan tanggung jawab lebih besar daripada percintaan,

Lihatlah keseharian seorang masinis kereta api yang menghubungkan kehidupan kita 🚆

We’ve thoroughly dug into the A to Z of what a train engineer does 👀

👉 Railway Driver’s License → Mandatory for Open Recruitment

👉 When you arrive at work, it starts with breathalyzer tests → safety training → equipment inspections!

The most important thing while operating!

👀 Drowsiness? It’s not about enduring it, but prevention.

👉 The reality is… it’s not as easy as you think 😂

A job with greater responsibility than romance,

en-US.title: If you block the parking lot entrance, we won't just let it slide anymore 🚫
en-US.description:
🚗 “It’s just for a moment, so it’ll be fine, right?”

Now,

blocking the entrances to apartment and commercial building parking lots,

will now be subject to fines of up to 5 million won and towing,

and management standards for long-term parking in public parking lots will also be strengthened!

📅 Starting in August 2026, the parking system is undergoing significant changes to create a safer and more convenient parking environment.

You will be able to experience parking lots that everyone can use with peace of mind sooner than you think. 🙌

Please join us in showing a little consideration for a convenient parking environment for everyone. 💛

#ParkingSystem #ImprovingParkingCulture #EliminatingIllegalParking

#LifeSafety #TrafficOrder #MinistryOfLandInfrastructureAndTransport #PolicyNotice

snippet.title: 기차 타고 떠나는 봄 여행, 반값으로 가능하다구? 🚆🌸#여행꿀팁 #기차여행
snippet.description:
바다 옆을 달리고 🌊
협곡 사이를 천천히 지나고 ⛰️
온돌방에서 누워 가는 기차까지…

국내에도 이렇게 특별한 기차 여행이 있다는 거, 알고 있었나요? 🚆

강릉→분천을 잇는 바다+협곡 코스부터
남해안을 따라 내려가는 남도 여행,
서해 감성 가득한 금빛 열차,
그리고 정선의 풍경까지 👀

👉 어디를 가든 ‘이동’이 아니라 ‘여행’이 되는 순간

게다가 지금은
4~5월 ‘여행 가는 달’ 혜택도 받을 수 있는걸요?

봄바람 딱 좋은 지금,
멀리 안 가도 충분히 설레는 여행 시작해보세요 🌸

이번엔 어디로 떠나볼까요? 🚆💭

snippet.title: 핸들 없이 움직이는 순간, 이동이 달라졌다 🚗
snippet.description:
“핸들… 안 잡아도 되네요?”

처음 타본 자율주행,
생각보다 더 조용하고 자연스럽게 움직입니다.

운전이 필요 없는 이동이 시작되면
누군가에겐 단순한 기술이 아니라
‘갈 수 있는 길’이 됩니다.

마을버스가 자주 오지 않는 곳에서도,
혼자 이동이 어려운 어르신들에게도,
이동은 더 이상 누군가의 도움이 아니라
스스로 선택할 수 있는 일이 됩니다.

지금은 낯설지만,
곧 익숙해질 변화.

en-US.title: The moment I moved without a handle, movement changed 🚗
en-US.description:
“I… don’t have to hold the steering wheel?”

My first experience with autonomous driving,

It moves more quietly and naturally than I expected.

Once driving-free mobility begins,

for some, it becomes not just a simple technology,

but a ‘path they can take.’

Even in places where village buses rarely run,

and for the elderly who find it difficult to move around alone,

mobility will no longer be something requiring someone else’s help,

but something they can choose for themselves.

It may feel unfamiliar now,

but it is a change that will soon become familiar.

🚗 Check out the current state of autonomous driving,

that we have experienced firsthand.

snippet.title: 도시 하나가, 자율주행으로 움직이기 시작했습니다 (feat. 화성 개소식)
snippet.description:
“자율주행, 어디까지 왔을까?”

화성에 그 답이 열렸습니다.

AI 자율주행 허브 개소,
그리고 도시 전체를 무대로 한 실증 시작.

200여 개 과제가 연결되고,
사람의 이동부터 도시 운영까지
자율주행이 하나의 흐름으로 이어집니다.

핸들을 잡지 않아도 되는 이동,
교통약자도 스스로 움직일 수 있는 길,
위험 상황까지 스스로 인지하는 기술.

이제 자율주행은
‘기술’이 아니라
‘도시의 일상’으로 확장됩니다.

국토교통부,
자율주행에 명운을 걸었습니다.

🚗 지금,
자율주행은 현실이 되고 있습니다.

a mere ‘technology’

to become

the daily life of the city.

The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport has staked its fate on autonomous driving.

🚗 Right now,

autonomous driving is becoming a reality.

every element of a hanok carries the wisdom of traditional Korean architecture.
